question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, 
           MIN(first_round) AS overall_first_round,
           MAX(last_round) AS overall_last_round
    FROM drives 
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_race_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id, ds.overall_first_round, ds.overall_last_round
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_seasons ds ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round <= ds.overall_first_round AND d.last_round >= ds.overall_first_round
),
last_race_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_seasons ds ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round <= ds.overall_last_round AND d.last_round >= ds.overall_last_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM first_race_constructor f
JOIN last_race_constructor l ON f.year = l.year AND f.driver_id = l.driver_id
JOIN drivers d ON f.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE f.constructor_id = l.constructor_id
  AND f.overall_first_round != f.overall_last_round
ORDER BY full_name

    SELECT year, driver_id, 
           MIN(first_round) AS overall_first_round,
           MAX(last_round) AS overall_last_round
    FROM drives 
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_race_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id, ds.overall_first_round, ds.overall_last_round
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_seasons ds ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round <= ds.overall_first_round AND d.last_round >= ds.overall_first_round
),
last_race_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_seasons ds ON d.year = ds.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE d.first_round <= ds.overall_last_round AND d.last_round >= ds.overall_last_round
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname) as total
FROM first_race_constructor f
JOIN last_race_constructor l ON f.year = l.year AND f.driver_id = l.driver_id
JOIN drivers d ON f.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE f.constructor_id = l.constructor_id
  AND f.overall_first_round != f.overall_last_round
